name: [SECURITY BREACH] Find the FNAF [322]
desc:
🔍Welcome to Find the FNAF! 🔍

How to play? 🏆🎮
Explore maps from your favourite FNAF games and discover characters along the way to complete your Index, and REBIRTH when you've collected them all, or have fun and roleplay with others by using the in-game morphs!

Updates will be regular, but Like 👍 and Favourite ⭐ for even more updates! If you have any feedback or suggestions, please join the group and let us know!

NEW UPDATES SOON 🔥 

This is a fun hunt experience based on the popular game Five Nights at Freddy's.
All rights are reserved to Scott Cawthon, the original creator of FNAF

scripts.title: All  Characters Instantly
scripts.features: Finds All The FNAF Characters Instantly
scripts.script:
for _,v in pairs(workspace.ToFind:GetChildren()) do
    v:PivotTo(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:GetPivot())
    task.wait(0.1)
end
